items.exampleEn: I saw her at the shop last week.
items.exampleZh: 我上週在那家店看到她。

items.exampleEn: My phone rang while I was cooking.
items.exampleZh: 我在煮飯的時候，手機響了。

items.exampleEn: Our team will play against Japan on Friday.
items.exampleZh: 我們的隊伍星期五要和日本隊比賽。

items.exampleEn: It was such a nice day.
Please turn off your phone during the meeting.
items.exampleZh: 開會期間請把手機關掉。

items.exampleEn: The next bus comes in ten minutes.
items.exampleZh: 下一班公車十分鐘後來。

items.exampleEn: He left the house without his bag.

items.sentenceEn: We might go to the beach next weekend.
items.sentenceZh: 我們下個週末可能會去海邊。

items.audioEn: During the summer, Amy works at a shop near the beach.
items.audioZh: 夏天的時候，Amy 在海邊附近的一家店工作。
options: At a shop near the beach

items.sentenceEn: I have never seen such a big dog.
items.sentenceZh: 我從來沒見過這麼大的狗。
她一句話也沒說就走了。

items.stemEn: Please don't use your phone ____ the movie.
items.stemZh: 看電影的時候請不要用手機。

items.stemEn: We played ____ a very strong team last Sunday.
items.stemZh: 我們上週日和一支很強的隊伍比賽。

items.passageEn: Last summer, Tom went to Japan with his family. During the trip, it rained almost every day, but they still had such a good time. They even went to the beach in the rain. One day, Tom went out without his umbrella and got very wet. While he was waiting for the bus, a kind old woman gave him hers. Next year, they might visit Japan again.
items.passageZh: 去年夏天，Tom 和家人去了日本。旅行期間幾乎每天都下雨，但他們還是玩得非常開心，甚至還冒著雨去了海邊。有一天，Tom 沒帶傘就出門，全身都濕了。他在等公車的時候，一位親切的老太太把她的傘給了他。明年他們可能會再去日本。

questions.questionZh: Tom 那天為什麼全身濕透？
明年他們可能會做什麼？

items.promptZh: 沒有你的幫忙，我做不完這份工作。
referenceEn: I can't finish this work without your help.
Without your help, I can't finish this job.
rubricZh: 用 without 表示「沒有」，後面接名詞（例如 your help）
「做不完」可寫成例如 can't finish、won't be able to finish 等
without 片語放句首或句尾都可以

items.instructionZh: 用 might 造一個句子，說說你這個週末可能會做的事。
referenceEn: I might go shopping with my sister this weekend.
I might stay home and watch movies on Saturday.
rubricZh: might 後面接原形動詞（例如 might go、might stay）
句子表達自己「可能、也許」會做的事，可加時間詞（例如 this weekend）
